title: Nisy Anjely marobe.
meterSource: No numerical time signature in the scan; each adjacent pair of printed two-pulse spans has been grouped as one four-pulse (4/4) measure for app compatibility.

measures.notesAboutNotation: Photo has a dark stain around the last bass and tenor notation; closing chord and exact fermata are not verified.

arrangement.opening: Solo (Treble na Tenor) with four-part organ accompaniment (Org.) for measures 1–8.
arrangement.soloRepresentation: measures[0..7].solo contains the separate printed solo melody. The standard four-part app view reads measure.voices, which contain the organ quartet; custom UI/playback support is required to show or mix the additional solo line.
arrangement.organRepresentation: measures[0..7].voices contains the printed four organ voices; the solo is stored separately.

notationConventions.raw: The colon (:) separates adjacent pulse cells. Internal | marks the midpoint between paired two-pulse spans in an editorial 4/4 grouping; it does not start another JSON measure.
notationConventions.rhythm: Long dash is continuation (held note), -r is a held half-cell followed by r, dot divides a cell. These subdivisions are inferred from printed source.
notationConventions.separateSolo: The solo melody has its own entry and is not included as a fifth part in default SATB playback.

issues: The printed page does not give a BPM or numerical meter; 4/4 is a practical grouping inferred from pairs of two-pulse sol-fa spans.

Two concurrent musical layers are printed at the beginning: Solo (Treble or Tenor) and organ accompaniment. The application’s standard SATB renderer cannot display five rows without an extra solo feature.
Small or indistinct low-octave letters in the scanned page, especially at the final bar, need confirmation against the printed original.
MIDI pitches and subdivision durations have not been independently checked by listening; pitch registers are conventional allocations.
The exact beat lengths of expressive/held notes and score underline markings are not fully encoded as verified rhythms.
